Literal small 'NSDF' stencil beneath the star. No other faction symbols. Distinct faction identity with original geometry-compatible atlas layout.
followups: Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix ONLY the large white NSDF star on the upper-left panel. Replace its current uneven, lopsided silhouette with a PRECISE REGULAR FIVE-POINT STAR: five equally spaced sharp outer tips, five equally spaced inner corners, exact 72-degree rotational geometry, perfectly bilateral symmetry about its upright central vertical axis. Center it on the inset panel with the same size and approximate position as the current star. Minimal small paint wear only inside the star, with its full clean symmetric outline visibly intact. Only correct the star shape.
